parameter-group.name: rules
parameter-group.label: Rule-Based Auto Approval
parameter-group.description: Automatically approve discovered things based on custom matching criteria and actions.

parameter.name: autoIgnore
parameter.label: Auto Ignore
parameter.description:
If enabled, an Inbox result matching an existing thing is automatically ignored.
If set to false, the Inbox may contain results although identical things already exist.

parameter.name: autoApprove
parameter.label: Auto Approve Everything Unconditionally
parameter.description: If enabled, all discovered things are automatically approved without evaluating rules, unless the inbox entry is ignored.

parameter.name: autoApproveRulesEnabled
parameter.label: Enable Rule-Based Auto Approval
parameter.description:
If enabled, discovered things are matched against defined rules below and automatically approved.
Note: Auto-approved items bypass the Inbox and appear directly under Settings → Things.

parameter.name: autoApproveRules
parameter.label: Auto Approve Rules
parameter.description:
Rules are evaluated sequentially until a match is found.
Syntax: criteriaKey=value; actionKey=value (Prefix with # or // to disable a rule)
Filters: thingUid, bridgeUid, label, representationProperty, propertyMatch, configMatch
Actions: setLabel, setLocation, setProperties, setConfig (optional post-approval customizations)
Example: thingUid=hue:*; label=*Motion*; setLocation=Living Room; setLabel=${label} Sensor
